scope_summary: Implemented the locked default-extra runtime recipe and same-pin identity migration, required EJS package/resource probe, separate optional-dependency wheel fixtures and repair/reuse regressions, CI-only offline real-image Deno bundle-load helper with orchestration negatives, and operator/evidence documentation. Excluded request/worker/protocol/pool/supervisor changes, pins, binary acquisition changes, Cargo dependencies, workflows, frozen design/spec edits, local native/uv/Docker execution and Git delivery.

changes.intent: Share the exact yt-dlp[default] requirement between uv installation and derived identity; retain schema 2 and publication flow; update shared-fixture caller and add baseline-formula same-pin migration/failure/offline-reuse tests, including valid EJS already present.
Require EJS distribution metadata, in-venv package and solver imports, and nonempty lib/core resources through package APIs; no Deno, installation or network in the production probe.
Model EJS as a distinct synthetic wheel selected only by yt-dlp's default-extra metadata, with deterministic package API resources and a shared wheel writer.

Supply offline EJS wheelhouse; retain mandatory-dependency/unrelated-extra assertions; add missing default-wheel boot rejection and missing package/metadata/solver/resource or empty-resource reuse rejection/repair assertions.
Load installed package bundles in upstream order and execute restricted stdin Deno with an explicit jsc-function marker; reject absent/empty bundles, failed processes and false zero-exit evidence.

Run the helper through the installed isolated venv Python in the offline resident container, preserving real entrypoint, stopped first boot, unavailable uv, unchanged-manifest/log reuse and cleanup checks.
Cover package and metadata absence, missing/empty bundles, ordered assembly, restricted Deno arguments, process errors/timeouts and mandatory explicit marker using lightweight mocks.
Assert installed-interpreter stdin handoff, offline resident placement after CLI shutdown and failure propagation with owned cleanup, without relaxing existing boot assertions.
Document upstream default extras, probe capability, same-pin recipe upgrade, first-repair dependency closure and unchanged offline reuse/stop-start ownership.
Separate mocked and synthetic fixture evidence from real-image bundle-load evidence and explicitly exclude live challenge, cookies, PO Token, SABR and format guarantees.
